title: Why does this program download so quickly? Can it speed up the Windows client?
body:
The tg of Windows client is so slow. All the programs I tried are so slow. Why is this program so fast? Is there any magic?
Is it possible to transplant it to make the client faster?
author: FishOrBear

comments.body: Hahaha, there is no magic. It is built using the official TDLib.
Well, you gave me a good inspiration, I modified the tg client and now it is also very fast.
